start.description: Start timestamp for the value.  If null, assumed to be beginning-of-time (BOT).

end.description: End timestamp for the value.  If null, assumed to be end-of-time (EOT).

from.description: The from side of the relation.

to.description: The to side of the relation.

title: Ties a start and end timestamp to the relationship between 2 entities.
name: TimedIntervalRelation
